description: Make a short-lived access link for a CRID this machine published, with the qURL CLI. The CLI verifies the link against the CRID before returning it. The link is a bearer secret: whoever has it can use it until it expires, so hand it only to the person it is for, show it once, and never put it in logs or public channels. Links are one-time use by default for local apps; if single_use is not true, say the link is reusable instead of calling it one-time. Do not open the link to test it. Choose the shortest workable ttl, such as 15m for a quick look. Make a fresh link for each recipient. A CRID alone grants nothing and is safe to share; list_crids shows this machine's CRIDs.

crid.description: CRID of a resource this machine published. A leading "$" marker is removed.

session_duration.description: How long the session lasts after the link is opened, as a Go duration such as "1h"; whole seconds only.

ttl.description: Requested link lifetime as a Go duration, such as "15m" or "1h"; whole seconds only. The service may grant less.

name: share_by_crid

name.description: Self-declared publisher name; not proof of identity

qurl.description: The access link. A bearer secret: give it only to its intended recipient

title: Share qURL by CRID
